Ran text recognition over every talent tooltip in eleven BlizzCon streams (Xaryu, Savix, Soda, Esfand, Payo, Pikabooirl and Guzu, both days) and compared each one with what the site shows. Five ranks were wrong and are fixed: Rogue Camouflage cuts the Stealth cooldown by 3, 4, 5 and 6 sec at ranks 2 to 5, not 4, 6, 8 and 10; Warlock Soul Siphon rank 3 cuts Drain Life healing by 20%, not 30%; Mage Permafrost rank 3 slows by an additional 10%, not 9%; Paladin Vindication is 42, 85 and 127 Attack Power, not 84 and 126; Mage Fingers of Frost rank 2 keeps the 15% chance and covers the next 2 spells, rather than 30% on 1 spell. Another 56 ranks that were estimates matched the footage word for word and now show as read. In-between ranks that sit between two read ranks now round like the game does instead of showing halves.
Rank 1 text changed.
Rank 1: 12 mana, instant. The next melee attack against you deals 20 Shadow damage to the attacker and cuts their melee attack power by 43 for 2 min.
Rank 1: 50 mana, instant, 20 yd, 2 min cooldown. 50 to 57 Holy damage and roots the target for up to 2 sec. Humanoids only, very low threat. Same idea as TBC.
Rank 1: 55 mana, instant, 3 min cooldown. For 15 sec, any spell that hits you burns 18 of the attacker's mana and deals 1 Shadow damage per point burned.
Rank 1: instant, 10 min cooldown. Heals you for 220 to 257.

Rank 3 at 38: 30 mana, instant. Shadows strike anyone who hits you with a spell, melee or ranged attack for 76 Shadow damage, once every few seconds, no threat. 3 charges, lasts 10 min. Rank 1 is 50 mana and 34 damage.
